Quan una IA respon amb text, podem llegi: When AI responds with text, we can read it before acting. When it controls a robot, its response can move an object, open a drawer or enter someone’s space. The move from language to movement changes the questions we need to ask about reliability, control and usefulness.
Google DeepMind va presentar Gemini Robo: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2 on 30 July 2026. The announcement describes whole-body control, dexterity and collaboration between robots. We treat these as capabilities reported by the manufacturer, not results we have verified in a real installation.
La proposta combina models que relacione: The approach combines models that connect images and instructions to actions with reasoning components for planning. DeepMind’s documentation distinguishes that planning from motor execution. The important point for readers is that a good verbal response does not, by itself, demonstrate that physical manipulation will succeed.
Consider the request “clear the table”. A useful test would define what a cleared table looks like, which objects may be moved and where they should go. A broken glass or a cup containing liquid should not disappear inside a single success score.
Una demostració no és un torn de feina: A demonstration is not a working shift
Un vídeo pot mostrar una tasca ben resol: A video can show a task completed well while leaving questions unanswered. How many attempts were made? How much preparation did the environment need? Was there any intervention? These are questions for evaluating a demonstration, not accusations about how a particular video was recorded.
La nostra proposta de lectura seria sepa: We suggest separating the task shown from the task a business needs. A warehouse might need work repeated for hours, with different objects and without blocking a walkway. That requirement cannot be inferred from a short sequence showing a single movement.
També caldria observar què passa quan el: It would also be useful to observe what happens when the system cannot continue. Stopping, asking for help and leaving the space safe are behaviours worth including in a test. The time required to recover from an exception is part of the process, even when it does not appear in a promotional video.
La utilitat es decideix al procés comple: Usefulness depends on the whole process
Per comparar una solució robòtica, propo: To compare a robotic solution, we suggest first describing the complete job: preparation, execution, verification and incidents. Then record where a person intervenes and why. This avoids confusing a visible improvement in one stage with automation from beginning to end.
El mateix criteri serveix per llegir afi: The same approach applies to claims of flexibility. Learning another task matters, but so do the data, time and support required to put it into operation. We have not measured these costs for Gemini Robotics; they are questions a subsequent evaluation should answer.
L’interès d’aquesta línia de recerca és: This research is interesting because it expands what a robot can understand and attempt. The distance to an everyday tool will be measured through repeatable tasks, explicit conditions and known limits. That is where a promising demonstration can begin to become a useful operation.

El problema apareix quan el sistema conf: The problem starts when a system confuses information it should read with instructions it is authorised to carry out.
Peça de context basada en recerca d’Anth: Context based on Anthropic research from November 2025 and OWASP documentation. This does not describe a new incident at Nintec.
Un agent rep l’encàrrec de comparar prov: An agent is asked to compare suppliers and visits a website. The page contains useful information, but also text that tries to change its task. The risk is not that the page has an opinion: it is that the system treats external content as an authoritative instruction.
Això és una forma d’injecció indirecta d: This is a form of indirect prompt injection. OWASP distinguishes it from instructions entered directly by the person using the system: here, the message arrives through a document, website or another source the agent consults.
Llegir una instrucció no és rebre autori: Reading an instruction does not grant authorisation
Per entendre el límit, proposem un exemp: Consider a simple example of the boundary. An assistant summarising an invoice must be able to read payment details. That does not mean the invoice can authorise a transfer. The document supplies data for the task; authorisation must come from the appropriate process and person.
Aquest exemple és conceptual, no un inci: This is a conceptual example, not an incident we have observed. It separates two questions: what does the material say, and what is the system allowed to do? If both answers come from the same external text, the boundary is poorly defined.
La defensa no depèn només del model: Defence does not depend on the model alone
Anthropic va explicar el novembre de 202: In November 2025, Anthropic described improvements in resistance for browser agents, while warning that prompt injection remained an open problem. A result from a manufacturer’s test does not mean immunity in every environment.
OWASP planteja defenses com restringir p: OWASP describes defences such as limiting privileges, separating external content and requiring human control for sensitive operations. It does not present any single measure as a complete solution. The practical question is how to reduce what can happen if the model misinterprets content.
En una revisió de disseny, preguntaríem: In a design review, we would ask whether an agent comparing prices also needs to send emails or modify customer data. If not, that capability adds nothing to the specific task. Separating operations makes it easier to understand the scope of an error and decide where to review the result.
Què convé observar en una prova: What to observe in a test
Un exercici útil seria comprovar que el: A useful exercise would check that the system continues to respect its original task when documents include unrelated instructions. The test should use fictional data and tools without real effects. Its purpose would be to observe the system’s boundaries, not expose customer information.
També caldria registrar quina informació: It would also be useful to record which information prompted an action and who authorised it. If a proposal to send something appears without the user requesting it, the process should make that deviation visible before it becomes a real communication.
La nostra lectura és que un agent útil n: Our view is that a useful agent needs access, but that access must correspond to a defined job. The decisive question is not just whether it can browse. It is whether it can read an environment it does not control without letting that environment decide, on its behalf, what it is authorised to do.
Si Google ja respon, qui visita la teva: If Google already answers, who visits your website?
Respostes amb IA i clics: què diu Pew |: AI answers and clicks: what Pew found | Nintec Journal
Un estudi de Pew ajuda a entendre els cl: A Pew study helps explain clicks when Google shows AI summaries. What it observes, its limits and how to interpret the findings.
Aparèixer en una resposta, rebre una vis: Appearing in an answer, receiving a visit and generating an enquiry are three different outcomes.
Anàlisi d’un estudi publicat el juliol d: Analysis of a study published in July 2025 using US browsing activity from March 2025. It does not measure your website’s current traffic.
Una resposta al cercador pot resoldre el: An answer in a search engine can resolve a question before the user opens a website. For publishers, that requires separating visibility from visits. For a business, it adds a third question: how much of that attention eventually produces a useful conversation?
Pew Research Center va publicar el julio: In July 2025, Pew Research Center published an analysis of browsing by 900 US adults. It observed clicks on traditional results in 8% of visits with an AI summary, compared with 15% without one. This is an observation from that sample, not a universal rate.
Què ens diu la dada i què no: What the figures tell us, and what they do not
La navegació estudiada correspon al març: The browsing studied took place in March 2025; search results were retrieved in April. That gap, and the possibility that summaries change, are among the limitations Pew describes. This is not an experiment randomly assigning the same search to two groups.
Per tant, no podem convertir la diferènc: We therefore cannot turn the difference into an exact forecast for a particular website. Nor does it mean that all visits will disappear. The editorial question that interests us is how to interpret search visibility when users can find part of the answer inside the search engine.
Una citació no és una visita: A citation is not a visit
Imaginem una pàgina que explica un conce: Imagine one page explaining a concept and another allowing someone to compare a service’s detailed terms. A short answer might satisfy the first intention; the second might require exploring options. This is an example for thinking about different needs, not a classification we have measured.
D’aquesta distinció surt una proposta de: That distinction suggests a practical approach: examine impressions, clicks and subsequent actions separately. Combining them into one number can make more appearances look like more opportunities. It can also lead to writing off an audience without checking what the people who do arrive actually do.
Google indica a la seva documentació que: Google’s documentation says that normal SEO practices remain relevant and that no special markup is required to appear in its AI features. That does not guarantee a page will be selected or receive any particular number of visits.
Què val la pena mesurar a la web pròpia: What is worth measuring on your own website
Proposem començar per preguntes que l’em: We suggest starting with questions a business can answer using its own data: which pages generate relevant enquiries, which content helps people decide and where browsing stops. Comparing periods requires taking campaign changes, seasonality and changes to the website itself into account.
Una prova editorial podria millorar una: An editorial test could improve a particular explanation and observe its development without promising an automatic effect on rankings. A page’s value can also lie in original examples, clear terms or information that helps someone take the next step.
La nostra lectura de Pew és que cal sepa: Our reading of Pew is that outcomes need to be separated before conclusions are drawn. Being visible, being visited and being chosen are not the same thing. The challenge is to understand that chain through your own data while search engines change how they present answers.

El debat sobre IA i feina sovint salta d: Debates about AI and work often jump from a capability to a conclusion: if a model can write a report, the job of the person who wrote it will disappear. Between those statements lie organisational choices, quality checks and other responsibilities that cannot fit inside a single demonstration.
L’Economic Index d’Anthropic publicat el: Anthropic’s Economic Index, published on 15 January 2026, analyses conversations from November 2025 and adds measures of complexity, autonomy and success. It is a window into Claude usage, with limitations the report acknowledges, not a picture of the entire labour market.
Una tasca no és una professió sencera: A task is not an entire profession
Imaginem una persona que prepara pressup: Imagine someone who prepares quotations. Writing the document is only part of the job: they may also need to clarify requirements, negotiate exceptions and check that commitments can be met. A tool helping with writing does not automatically resolve the rest of that process.
L’estudi de l’OIT de maig de 2025 mesura: The ILO’s May 2025 study measures task exposure to generative AI. It considers job transformation more likely than complete replacement in many occupations, because they continue to involve human input. Exposure means potential for change, not observed redundancies.
Mesurar ús també exigeix llegir el mètod: Measuring usage also means reading the methodology
Anthropic adverteix que les persones pod: Anthropic notes that people may choose tasks they believe the model will handle well. They can also break tasks down and correct results. This matters when comparing real conversations with fixed tests: they do not observe exactly the same situation.
La nostra lectura és que cal mantenir se: Our view is that technical capability, adoption and organisational effects should remain separate. A company can test a tool without deploying it. It can deploy it and redistribute work. It may also need more review than expected. None of these steps follows from a conversation count alone.
També seria inadequat presentar una esti: It would also be inappropriate to present estimated time savings as a direct measure of net benefit. La pregunta útil dins d’una empresa: The useful question inside a business
Proposem observar un procés concret dura: We suggest observing a specific process over a defined period. Which tasks change? Who reviews the result? Which errors need correcting? Which hours can be used for other work? That record would be more useful for internal decisions than extrapolating a global headline.
L’exemple d’un equip de suport ho mostra: A support team offers an example: the time needed to prepare a reply could be separated from the time needed to resolve the case. If the message goes out sooner but the problem remains open, an improvement in one stage does not explain the whole customer experience.
Els estudis ofereixen vocabulari i senya: The studies provide language and signals for investigating change. They do not determine how benefits will be shared or which policies each company will adopt. The question we suggest tracking is what changes in actual work and what evidence supports it, without turning a technical possibility into an inevitable future for employment.

Els centres de dades necessiten més que: Data centres need more than chips. We examine IEA analysis of electricity, connections and the physical constraints on AI growth.

Una aplicació d’IA pot semblar immateria: An AI application can seem immaterial: it opens in a browser, receives a request and returns an answer. L’informe de l’IEA d’abril de 2026 situa: The IEA’s April 2026 report identifies grid connections and supply chains among the factors shaping expansion. It also distinguishes the efficiency of an individual task from total consumption: more usage can coexist with less energy per operation.
Eficiència i demanda responen preguntes: Efficiency and demand answer different questions
Un exemple aritmètic ajuda a veure-ho. S: An arithmetic example makes this clear. If a hypothetical task uses half the energy but runs four times as often, total consumption doubles. This is not a measurement of a particular model; it shows why an individual improvement does not determine the aggregate result.
També importa què s’està comptant. Una r: What is being counted matters too. A short answer and a job involving many consecutive operations are not equivalent units. Before comparing figures, identify the task, observation period and equipment included. Without that boundary, a very precise number may answer a different question from the one that matters.
Tenir energia no és tenir-la al lloc ade: Having energy is not having it in the right place
L’IEA assenyala que la concentració de d: The IEA notes that concentrated demand and different investment timetables can create local pressures. The report also avoids assuming a single effect on prices: the outcome depends on the balance between supply and demand and on electricity-system decisions.
Per interpretar un anunci d’infraestruct: When reading an infrastructure announcement, we suggest separating planned location, agreed connection, construction and operation. An announced project is not a centre already drawing all its planned power. Installed capacity alone does not explain how much energy is used over a year either.
Aquesta distinció ajuda a formular pregu: This distinction helps frame specific questions. When will it enter service? Which infrastructure is available? What utilisation has been measured? Readers do not need to become engineers: they need to avoid having different project stages compressed into one impressive number.
Què hauria d’acompanyar una promesa de c: What should accompany a promise of growth
La nostra lectura és que els anuncis de: Our view is that capacity announcements become more useful when they explain their dependencies. A timetable with verifiable milestones makes it possible to check what has been completed and what remains pending. A projection without conditions can look like a fact even when it depends on construction, equipment or future demand.
Per a una empresa que utilitza IA, aques: For a business using AI, this debate provides context about continuity and availability, not an automatic prediction of its bill. The specific contract, service type and usage remain necessary to understand the cost it will actually bear.
La cursa de la IA inclou allò que es veu: The AI race includes what appears on screen and what supports it. Looking at the electricity grid requires keeping two scales together: the efficiency of an operation and the infrastructure that lets it be repeated. Growth will need to be verified at both levels.

MCP facilita la connexió entre aplicacio: MCP helps connect AI applications, data and tools. What it standardises and why permissions still matter.
Una manera comuna de connectar sistemes: A common way to connect systems does not give an agent permission to do everything.
Guia de context. La Linux Foundation va: Background guide. The Linux Foundation announced MCP’s contribution to the Agentic AI Foundation in December 2025; technical documentation was checked for this article.
Una IA pot explicar molt bé què caldria: AI can explain what should be done very well while lacking access to the information needed to do it. The gap between a general answer and a useful action often involves connecting documents, applications and specific operations. This is where Model Context Protocol, or MCP, comes in.
La documentació del protocol defineix un: The protocol documentation defines a client-server architecture for exchanging context and exposing capabilities. These include executable tools, data resources and interaction templates. MCP organises communication; it does not dictate an AI application’s entire logic.
Imaginem un assistent que ajuda a prepar: Imagine an assistant helping prepare meetings. One connection could read a calendar and another retrieve authorised documents. The application would use that information to prepare a summary. This is a design example, not a claim that every calendar or repository automatically works with every agent.
Perquè el procés sigui útil, encara cald: For the process to be useful, it would still need to know which customer is involved, which documents are relevant and what happens if a query fails. Speaking a common protocol facilitates part of the exchange, but does not decide those business rules.
Un estàndard compartit, no una connexió: A shared standard, not guaranteed universal connectivity
El 9 de desembre de 2025, la Linux Found: On 9 December 2025, the Linux Foundation announced the Agentic AI Foundation, with MCP among its founding project contributions. Shared governance matters for following the protocol’s development, but should not be confused with certification of every server using it.
Per avaluar una connexió concreta, propo: To assess a particular connection, we suggest reviewing which operations it offers, which version it supports and who maintains it. A protocol name in a presentation does not answer those questions. Behaviour when data is missing or the connected service is unavailable also needs testing.
La comparació amb un endoll és útil nomé: The comparison with a plug is useful only up to a point: it helps picture a shared interface, but can hide the fact that meaning and permissions also pass through it. A misinterpreted instruction remains misinterpreted even when it travels in the correct format.
En l’exemple de les reunions, consultar: In the meeting example, checking a free time and cancelling an appointment are different actions. A configuration may need the first but not the second. The design should make that difference visible and testable, rather than treating all calendar access as one package.
Una prova que proposem és retirar una ca: One test we suggest is removing a capability and checking that the assistant explains the limitation without inventing a result. Another is reviewing what gets recorded after an operation. The aim is to treat the connection as an inspectable part of the process, not a box that simply “integrates AI”.
MCP interessa perquè dona una base comun: MCP matters because it offers a common foundation for a recurring job: making tools and context available to an application. Its eventual value will be demonstrated by what the connection can resolve, within which limits and with clear responsibility for the actions it performs.

Les credencials de contingut poden expli: Content credentials can explain a file’s provenance. Why that does not replace checking what it shows and the context in which it is published.
Saber d’on ve un arxiu ajuda a interpret: Knowing where a file comes from helps interpret it. It does not automatically make its content or caption true.

Una fotografia pot ser real i, alhora, s: A photograph can be real and still be used to tell a false story. An old scene only needs a caption presenting it as something that happened today. Trust in images therefore has more than one layer: the file, its provenance and its context.
C2PA proposa un mecanisme per associar i: C2PA proposes a mechanism for associating verifiable information about content creation and handling. Its principles distinguish that provenance from judgements about whether the material is good or bad. Verifying an association does not verify the entire story someone tells with the image.
El valor d’un historial és aportar infor: A history is valuable because it supplies information for better questions. Who declared an operation? Which part of the journey is documented? What does the credential being checked actually say? Those questions should not be replaced by a general impression of an “approved photo”.
Imaginem una fotografia d’un acte públic: Imagine a photograph of a public event republished years later. Even if the file retains valid information about its origin, the new caption could place it somewhere else or at another time. This example shows why we need to read the text accompanying a file, not just inspect the file itself.
Sense credencials no vol dir fals: No credentials does not mean false
Una fotografia d’arxiu pot continuar sen: An archive photograph can remain a useful source if its provenance can be investigated in other ways. Conversely, a technical chain of data does not by itself resolve the meaning of a scene. Both questions deserve their own space: what do we know about the file, and what can we support about the event depicted?
També cal evitar que una interfície simp: An interface should also avoid oversimplifying the answer. From an editorial perspective, an indicator should help explain what was checked rather than suggest that every claim associated with the photograph has received independent validation.
Com llegiríem una imatge amb aquesta inf: How we would read an image with this information
Proposem començar pel que afirma la publ: We suggest starting with what the publication claims: person, place, date and event. Then check the original source and examine what the credential adds. If there is a gap, describing it is better than filling it with a conclusion the available information cannot support.
En aquest Journal, per exemple, un peu q: In this Journal, for example, a caption saying “archive photograph” separates the image from the date of the news. La nostra lectura és que la procedència: Our view is that provenance can strengthen verification when communicated precisely. The step to avoid is turning a technical check into a guarantee of truth. Knowing more about a file is useful because it lets us keep asking questions, not because it removes the need to ask them.
